profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer - AI Fanatic - Drummer - Amateur Filmmaker
profile.summary:
As a Full Stack Web Developer with expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies, I manage the development lifecycle of web applications, delivering responsive, high-performance websites. In previous roles, I have developed seamless user interfaces and integrated complex back-end systems, ensuring applications are scalable, secure, and user-friendly. By collaborating closely with designers and stakeholders, I successfully transform business requirements into technical solutions, driving innovation and delivering exceptional user experiences.

In addition to my technical skills, my entrepreneurial experience as an Independent Distributor and owner of SLM Construction has sharpened my leadership, project management, and client relationship-building skills. These roles have provided me with the ability to drive growth, manage teams, and handle complex challenges effectively. Together, these diverse experiences allow me to contribute valuable insights and leadership in the web development industry.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
➣ Lead the development of web applications, handling both front-end and back-end tasks to create cohesive solutions.
➣ Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, ensuring that projects align with business goals.
➣ Continuously improve codebase performance, scalability, and security while maintaining high-quality user interfaces.
➣ Oversee all stages of development, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance, ensuring seamless project execution.

positions.title: Backend Web Developer
positions.description:
➣ Built and maintained server-side logic and APIs using languages such as Node.js, PHP, and Python to support web applications.
➣ Integrated third-party services, databases, and APIs to enhance functionality and streamline user interactions.
➣ Ensured security and data protection through robust back-end solutions, adhering to industry best practices.
➣ Optimized database performance, ensuring fast and reliable data retrieval for large-scale applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Performance Optimization · UI/UX Design

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
➣ Developed responsive and visually appealing user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring seamless user experiences.
➣ Worked closely with designers to transform concepts into functional websites, integrating user-centric design principles.
➣ Optimized front-end performance, reducing load times and improving overall user engagement.
➣ Collaborated with backend developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.

positions.title: Independent Distributor
positions.description:
➣ Managed and expanded a personal sales territory, building lasting relationships with customers and fostering brand loyalty.
➣ Conducted product demonstrations and provided exceptional customer service to educate clients on product benefits and usage.
➣ Promoted and sold health and wellness products, increasing sales through personalized marketing strategies.
➣ Developed a team of distributors, providing training and support to help achieve team goals and drive company growth.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
➣ Founded and managed a construction business, overseeing all operations from project planning to completion.
➣ Ensured project timelines and budgets were adhered to, delivering high-quality construction services to clients.
➣ Built strong relationships with clients, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure seamless project execution.
➣ Managed a team of skilled professionals, providing leadership and training to enhance productivity and project outcomes.
